label: GO step, strong a1 choice after a rewarded a1 trial, mid-episode (trials ~35-65); decays over a reward streak
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew was 1 at D1) and the previous choice was a1 (or unknown at window start), and only when the agent is about to choose a1 with a very confident policy logit (choice > 8.07, top ~10% of steps; 100% of mass). Nearly all activity is when S1 is the good state. A strong, odd dependence on episode position: there is no activity before trial ~30 or after ~70, and it peaks at trials 40-60, so the unit seems to follow a slow drift in the hidden state across the episode. Magnitude is largest on the first rewarded a1 trial after an unrewarded trial or a reset, and falls off over consecutive rewarded trials (e.g. 0.98 -> 0.63 -> 0.38 -> 0.17). Long unbroken reward streaks make up most of the false positives, though adding conditions on the reward history did not raise F1. Uses only observed variables plus the GO policy logit of the agent itself. Dev: F1 0.58, mass recall 0.99, precision 0.41.
